outcomes.mode_effective_note: auto is preserved for read intent; this is acceptable if downstream tool gateway enforces escalation at execution time

notes: BUG EXPOSED (report only, no patch): When mode=auto and the prompt implies write intent, governance.mode_requires_escalation correctly returns true, but the runtime still reports mode_effective=auto after create_run/execute_run. The LangGraph parity runtime does not escalate mode_effective to build_required/auto-build. For read intent under auto, mode_effective stays auto (acceptable if tool gateway enforces escalation at execution). However, the write-intent/auto case is a governance/failure-mode gap: the run state should reflect that escalation is required (e.g., mode_effective=build_required or status=blocked) before any write tool is scheduled. No source code modified.
